summary: Verified the new Database Backup feature (bug fix for 'backup not working') end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests passed covering auth enforcement (401/403 unauthenticated + bad token on create/list/download/delete), POST /api/admin/backup/create (real mongodump, 46 collections, ~427KB zip), GET /api/admin/backup/list, GET /api/admin/backup/{id}/download (Content-Type zip, verified zip contains 46 .bson + 46 .metadata.json incl. users.bson, contacts.bson, properties.bson with non-empty content), DELETE /api/admin/backup/{id} (removed from list, download then 404), plus 404s for non-existent ids. Frontend: logged in as super admin, /settings/admin/backup loads real stats (Total Backup Size, Backups Stored count, Backup Status = Healthy/No Backups Yet), 'Backup Now' created a real row (backup_2026-08-20_08-07-35.zip, 46 collections, 427.8 KB, real timestamp) with success toast, Download triggered a genuine .zip download (438,058 bytes, 46 .bson files verified via zipfile), Delete removed the row with toast and stats updated (2 -> 1). No console errors. Feature is real and working — original mock/fake behavior is fully gone.

minor.issue: No retention/disk-usage cap — unlimited backups accumulate in /app/backend/backups; consider max-N retention or disk quota.
No audit_log entry written for backup creation/deletion even though the app has an audit log for other admin actions.

collection_count is computed from db.list_collection_names() rather than from the actual dumped .bson files; if mongodump partially skipped a collection the count would still look correct (currently they match: 46/46).

issues: No confirmation dialog before deleting a backup (single click permanently deletes the zip) — minor UX risk
The old 'Restore' action was removed entirely; if restore is expected functionality it is now absent (mongorestore is available in env)

action_items: Optional: add delete confirmation dialog on backup rows
Optional: add retention limit for stored backups and audit-log entries for create/delete
critical_code_review_comments: db_backup.py is clean: async subprocess for mongodump, _id excluded from list/create responses, superuser-only via require_role, env-based MONGO_URL/DB_NAME. No blocking issues found.
Backups are stored on the container filesystem (/app/backend/backups) which is ephemeral in preview/deploy — note that downloaded copies are the durable artifact.
seed_data_creation: Created and deleted transient backups via API and UI. One pre-existing backup zip (f7118b1f-...zip, created 08:05 by prior manual verification) remains in /app/backend/backups and in db.db_backups; harmless.

Backup creation takes ~1-2s for this DB, so the UI spinner state is only visible for a moment (not a bug). Backend WatchFiles reloads when files under /app/backend/tests are written — expect a short backend reload after creating test files.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: DatabaseBackup.jsx was fully mocked (setTimeout, hardcoded Jan-2025 history, no onClick on Download/Restore) and no backend backup endpoints existed. Fix adds backend/routes/db_backup.py (mongodump -> zip -> metadata in db.db_backups) and rewires the page to real API calls. Verified genuine full-database export (46 collections .bson) downloads to the browser.
